id: location-manager-heading\n    content: \"LocationManager: Heading-Pipeline hinzufügen (Course + Compass mischen, glätten, userHeading/isHeadingValid publizieren)\"\n    status: completed\n  - id: user-heading-annotation\n    content: UserHeadingAnnotationView Komponente erstellen mit HeadingArrowShape und korrekter Rotation\n    status: completed\n  - id: user-marker-integration\n    content: \"iPhone_DeviceNavigationView: User-Marker mit UserHeadingAnnotationView erweitern, Map-Heading tracken\"\n    status: completed\n  - id: double-tap-reverse\n    content: Double-Tap Handler für Reverse-Modus erweitern (Navigation-Modus aktivieren)\n    status: completed\n  - id: follow-camera-user-heading\n    content: Follow-Camera mit User-Heading erweitern, Rotation nur bei Navigation-Modus\n    status: completed\n  - id: initial-fit-animation\n    content: Initiale Fit-Animation + verzögerter Zoom (2.5s) bei Navigation-Start implementieren\n    status: completed\nisProject: false\n---\n\n# Plan: Reverse Navigation Double-Tap Mode\n\n## Zielbild\n\nWenn ein User im Reverse-Navigations-Modus (&#96;isRouteReversed == true&#96;) per Double-Tap die Karte auf Navigation schaltet, sollen folgende Änderungen aktiviert werden:\n\n- **User-Location-Annotation mit Blickrichtungspfeil**: Custom-Annotation mit Richtungspfeil, der die aktuelle Blickrichtung anzeigt und korrekt rotiert (berücksichtigt Kartenrotation)\n- **Kartenrotation**: Die Karte rotiert um die Blickrichtung des Users während der Navigation\n- **Follow-Camera**: Kamera folgt dem User mit weichen Animationen\n- **Initiale Sequenz**: Route wird gefittet, dann nach 2.5s in den Navigation-Look gezoomt\n\n## Aktuelle Situation\n\n- &#96;handleMapDoubleTap()&#96; funktioniert nur wenn &#96;!isRouteReversed&#96; ist (Zeile 1115)",

        "contents": "## Aktuelle Situation\n\n- &#96;handleMapDoubleTap()&#96; funktioniert nur wenn &#96;!isRouteReversed&#96; ist (Zeile 1115)\n- &#96;LocationManager&#96; hat keine Heading-Logik (nur Course aus &#96;currentLocation?.course&#96;)\n- &#96;userMarkerContent&#96; verwendet &#96;MiataruMapMarker&#96; ohne Heading-Pfeil\n- &#96;updateFollowCamera()&#96; verwendet &#96;currentDeviceHeading()&#96; (Device-Heading statt User-Heading)\n- &#96;onMapCameraChange&#96; trackt bereits &#96;currentMapCamera?.heading&#96;, wird aber nicht für Pfeil-Rotation verwendet\n\n## Implementierungsschritte\n\n### 1. LocationManager: Heading-Pipeline hinzufügen\n\n**Datei**: &#96;[miataru/LocationManagers/LocationManager.swift](miataru/LocationManagers/LocationManager.swift)&#96;\n\n- &#96;CLLocationManager&#96; für Heading-Updates konfigurieren (&#96;startUpdatingHeading()&#96;)\n- &#96;@Published var userHeading: Double?&#96; hinzufügen\n- &#96;@Published private(set) var isHeadingValid: Bool = false&#96; hinzufügen\n- Heading-Logik implementieren:\n  - Course (bei Bewegung) mit Compass-Heading (bei Stillstand) mischen\n  - Exponential-Smoothing mit Wrap-Around bei 0/360\n  - &#96;isHeadingValid&#96; basierend auf Heading-Qualität setzen\n- &#96;CLLocationManagerDelegate&#96; erweitern: &#96;locationManager(_:didUpdateHeading:)&#96;\n\n**Referenz**: ToiletFinder &#96;LocationManager.swift&#96; Zeilen 18-127\n\n### 2. UserHeadingAnnotationView Komponente erstellen\n\n**Neue Datei**: &#96;miataru/views/Common/Map/UserHeadingAnnotationView.swift&#96;\n\n- Custom-View mit Layer-Aufbau:\n  - Außenring: &#96;Circle().fill(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.16)).frame(width: 36, height: 36)&#96;\n  - Kontur: &#96;Circle().stroke(Color.accentColor.opacity(0.5), lineWidth: 2).frame(width: 28, height: 28)&#96;\n  - Innerer Kern: &#96;Circle().fill(Color.white.opacity(0.8)).frame(width: 22, height: 22)&#96; mit Drop-Shadow\n  - Heading-Pfeil: &#96;HeadingArrowShape()&#96; nur sichtbar wenn &#96;isHeadingValid&#96;\n  - Punktkern: &#96;Circle().fill(Color.accentColor).frame(width: 10, height: 10)&#96;\n- &#96;HeadingArrowShape&#96;: Dreieck mit Spitze oben (&#96;tipY = -11&#96;, &#96;baseY = 2&#96;, &#96;halfBase = 4.5&#96;)\n- Pfeil-Rotation: &#96;rotationEffect(.degrees((heading ?? 0) - mapHeading))&#96; für korrekte Bildschirmrichtung\n\n**Referenz**: ToiletFinder &#96;UserHeadingAnnotationView.swift&#96; Zeilen 10-50",

        "contents": "### Heading-Glättung\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;swift\nprivate func smoothHeading(_ newHeading: Double) -&gt; Double {\n    let normalized = normalizedHeading(newHeading)\n    guard let last = lastSmoothedHeading else {\n        lastSmoothedHeading = normalized\n        return normalized\n    }\n    let delta = normalized - last\n    let wrappedDelta: Double = {\n        if delta &gt; 180 { return delta - 360 }\n        if delta &lt; -180 { return delta + 360 }\n        return delta\n    }()\n    let smoothed = normalizedHeading(last + wrappedDelta * headingSmoothingAlpha)\n    lastSmoothedHeading = smoothed\n    return smoothed\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Map-Heading Tracking\n\n- &#96;onMapCameraChange&#96; liefert &#96;context.camera.heading&#96; kontinuierlich\n- In &#96;@State&#96; speichern und für Pfeil-Rotation verwenden\n\n### Animation-Timing\n\n- Kamera-Updates: &#96;.easeInOut(duration: 0.35)&#96;\n- Initial Fit: &#96;.easeInOut(duration: 0.35)&#96;\n- Verzögerung vor Zoom: 2.5 Sekunden\n\n## Risiken/Abweichungen\n\n- **iOS-Version**: &#96;MapCamera(heading:)&#96; nur iOS 17+; Fallback auf &#96;region&#96; für ältere Versionen\n- **Heading-Verfügbarkeit**: Compass-Heading erfordert Gerätebewegung; bei fehlendem Heading Fallback auf Course\n- **Map-Update-Loop**: &#96;isProgrammaticCameraChange&#96; verhindert unerwünschte Re-Searches; Logik beibehalten\n\n## Test-Validierung\n\n- Check: Pfeil zeigt stets \"screen-forward\" bei Kartendrehung\n- Check: Double-Tap aktiviert Navigation-Modus auch bei &#96;isRouteReversed == true&#96;\n- Check: Karte rotiert mit User-Heading während Navigation\n- Check: Initiale Sequenz: Fit → 2.5s → Zoom, danach flüssige Folgebewegung\n- Check: Heading-Pfeil verschwindet wenn &#96;isHeadingValid == false&#96;",

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>

Looking at the code, I can see:

1. There's a double-tap navigation mode that's activated when `isRouteReversed == true` and the user double-taps the map
2. The `enableNavigationMode()` function (line 1259) sets up navigation mode
3. The `updateFollowCamera()` function (line 1303) handles camera updates during navigation
4. Currently, the camera uses `pitch` from `currentMapCamera?.pitch ?? 0` (line 1312), which means it preserves the current pitch or defaults to 0 (flat/overhead view)

The user wants the map to be angled by default when in double-tap navigation mode so more of the map/route can be seen. This means I need to set a pitch angle (like 45 degrees) when entering navigation mode.

Looking at the `enableNavigationMode()` function:
- It first fits the route region
- Then after 2.5 seconds, it calls `performInitialNavigationZoom()` which sets up the camera with the current pitch (line 1334)

I should modify this to set a pitch angle (like 45 degrees) when entering navigation mode. The pitch should be set in:
1. `enableNavigationMode()` - when initially setting up
2. `performInitialNavigationZoom()` - when doing the initial zoom
3. `updateFollowCamera()` - when updating the camera during navigation

Let me check what a good pitch value would be. In MapKit, pitch is typically 0-90 degrees, where 0 is overhead and 90 is straight ahead. A pitch of around 45-60 degrees is common for navigation views to show more of the route ahead.

Let me search for any existing pitch settings in the codebase.

## Summary

Updated `stopNavigation()` to:

1. Exit navigation modes: calls `disableNavigationMode()` and/or `disableFollowDeviceHeadingMode()` if active. These functions:
   - Set `isNavigationMode = false` and `isFollowDeviceHeadingMode = false`
   - Reset the camera via `resetZoomToFitRouteOrBoth()` to show the full route

2. Clear navigation overlay: removes the navigation overlay UI elements

3. Recalculate route: calls `calculateRoute(ignoreCache: true)` to refresh the route

4. Update UI: updates the bottom accessory to reflect that navigation has stopped

When navigation stops automatically (devices get within 50m), the app will:
- Exit double-tap navigation mode
- Exit follow device heading mode (if active)
- Reset the camera to show the full route
- Recalculate and display the route
- Show the info message that navigation stopped automatically

The route remains visible (not cleared) so users can see the full path they took.

(maxScreens / maxRatio) : 1\n        let latRatio = latRatioRaw * scale\n        let lonRatio = lonRatioRaw * scale\n\n        let screenX = screenCenter.x + lonRatio * screenSize.width\n        let screenY = screenCenter.y - latRatio * screenSize.height // Inverted Y axis\n        \n        // Debug: Print coordinate conversion details\n        debugLog(\"🌍 Device \\(deviceName) coordinate: \\(coordinate.latitude), \\(coordinate.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"🗺️ Map region center: \\(mapRegion.center.latitude), \\(mapRegion.center.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"📏 Map span: \\(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta), \\(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta)\")\n        debugLog(\"📊 Ratios (raw/scaled): lat=\\(latRatioRaw)→\\(latRatio), lon=\\(lonRatioRaw)→\\(lonRatio)\")\n        debugLog(\"🖥️ Screen center: \\(screenCenter), screen size: \\(screenSize)\")\n        debugLog(\"🎯 Calculated screen position: \\(screenX), \\(screenY)\")\n        \n        return CGPoint(x: screenX, y: screenY)\n    }\n    ",

        "contents": "            return\n        }\n        \n        if let user = userCoordinate, let dest = deviceCoordinate,\n           (!hasSetInitialRegion || recenter || isAutoCenteringEnabled) {\n            if isFollowDeviceHeadingMode {\n                updateFollowCamera(animated: true)\n                hasSetInitialRegion = true\n                return\n            }\n            let region = regionThatFits(user: user, dest: dest)\n            isProgrammaticCameraChange = true\n            if animationsAllowed {\n                withAnimation {\n                    mapPosition = .region(region)\n                }\n            } else {\n                mapPosition = .region(region)\n            }\n            hasSetInitialRegion = true\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func regionThatFits(user: CLLocationCoordinate2D, dest: CLLocationCoordinate2D) -&gt; MKCoordinateRegion {\n        // Compute a region that fits both points with padding and minimum span to avoid over-zooming\n        let center = CLLocationCoordinate2D(latitude: (user.latitude + dest.latitude) / 2,\n                                            longitude: (user.longitude + dest.longitude) / 2)\n        let baseLat = abs(user.latitude - dest.latitude)\n        let baseLon = abs(user.longitude - dest.longitude)\n        let paddedLat = max(baseLat * fitPaddingMultiplier, fitMinimumSpan.latitudeDelta)\n        let paddedLon = max(baseLon * fitPaddingMultiplier, fitMinimumSpan.longitudeDelta)\n        let span = MKCoordinateSpan(latitudeDelta: paddedLat, longitudeDelta: paddedLon)\n        return MKCoordinateRegion(center: center, span: span)\n    }\n\n    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false, retryAttempt: Int = 0) {\n        ",

        "contents": "    private func computeOffscreenDevicesByEdge(region: MKCoordinateRegion) -&gt; [Edge: [ArrowData]] {\n        var devicesByEdge: [Edge: [ArrowData]] = [:]\n        \n        // Current device\n        if let device = device, let coordinate = deviceLocation,\n           let edge = OffscreenDeviceEdgeHelper.edge(\n                for: coordinate,\n                in: region,\n                screenSize: screenSize,\n                heading: currentMapCamera?.heading ?? 0\n            ) {\n            let tap = {\n                if animationsAllowed {\n                    withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.8)) {\n                        if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                            if let currentRegion = cameraPosition.region {\n                                cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentRegion.span))\n                            }\n                        } else {\n                            self.region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: self.region.span)\n                        }\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    if #available(iOS 17.0, *) {\n                        if let currentRegion = cameraPosition.region {\n                            cameraPosition = .region(MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: currentRegion.span))\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        self.region = MKCoordinateRegion(center: coordinate, span: self.region.span)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            let deviceLocation = CLLocation(latitude: coordinate.latitude, longitude: coordinate.longitude)\n            let centerLocation = CLLocation(latitude: region.center.latitude, longitude: region.center.longitude)\n            let distanceKM = deviceLocation.distance(from: centerLocation) / 1000.0\n            devicesByEdge[edge, default: []].append(ArrowData(device: device, coordinate: coordinate, distanceKM: distanceKM, behavior: .jumpToLocation, onTap: tap))\n        }\n        \n        // Other devices",

Updated the code to set the pitch angle immediately when entering navigation mode. The issue was using `.region()`, which resets pitch to 0, and the delayed update wasn't reliable.

## Changes Made

1. **Direct camera with pitch**: Instead of using `.region()` and then trying to update pitch later, the code now converts the route region to a `MapCamera` with `navigationPitch` (50 degrees) immediately.

2. **Distance calculation**: Estimates the camera distance from the region span to create a properly positioned camera.

3. **Immediate pitch application**: The map is tilted from the start when entering double-tap navigation mode.

When you double-tap to enter navigation mode, the map should now be tilted at 50 degrees to show more of the route ahead. The pitch is maintained during navigation updates via `updateFollowCamera()` and `performInitialNavigationZoom()`.

        "contents": "    private func shouldUpdateFollowCamera(center: CLLocationCoordinate2D, heading: CLLocationDirection, force: Bool) -&gt; Bool {\n        let now = Date()\n        if force {\n            lastFollowCameraUpdate = now\n            lastFollowCameraCenter = center\n            lastFollowCameraHeading = heading\n            return true\n        }\n        if let lastTime = lastFollowCameraUpdate, now.timeIntervalSince(lastTime) &lt; followUpdateMinInterval {\n            return false\n        }\n        var shouldUpdate = false\n        if let lastCenter = lastFollowCameraCenter {\n            let lastLocation = CLLocation(latitude: lastCenter.latitude, longitude: lastCenter.longitude)\n            let newLocation = CLLocation(latitude: center.latitude, longitude: center.longitude)\n            let distance = newLocation.distance(from: lastLocation)\n            shouldUpdate = distance &gt;= followUpdateMinDistance\n        } else {\n            shouldUpdate = true\n        }\n        if let lastHeading = lastFollowCameraHeading {\n            let delta = abs(lastHeading - heading)\n            let wrappedDelta = min(delta, 360 - delta)\n            shouldUpdate = shouldUpdate || wrappedDelta &gt;= followUpdateMinHeadingDelta\n        } else {\n            shouldUpdate = true\n        }\n        if shouldUpdate {\n            lastFollowCameraUpdate = now\n            lastFollowCameraCenter = center\n            lastFollowCameraHeading = heading\n        }\n        return shouldUpdate\n    }\n\n    private func followCameraDistanceForNextStep() -&gt; CLLocationDistance? {\n        guard let route,\n              let location = locationManager.currentLocation,",

0\n                Button(action: {\n                    isAutoCenteringEnabled = true\n                    alignMapToNorth()\n                }) {\n                    MapCompass(heading: heading, size: 40)\n                }\n                .padding([.top, .trailing], 10)\n                .zIndex(3)\n                .transition(animationsAllowed ?         "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false, retryAttempt: Int = 0) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        if retryAttempt == 0 {\n            routeRetryTask?.cancel()\n            routeRetryTask = nil\n            pendingRouteRetryOnReconnect = false\n        }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\n            destination = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\n        } else {\n            source = MKMapItem.forCurrentLocation()\n            destination = MKMapItem(placemark: MKPlacemark(coordinate: dest))\n            destination.name = device.DeviceName.isEmpty ? device.DeviceID : device.DeviceName\n        }\n        var options: [String: Any] = [:]\n        switch settings.navigationTransportType {\n        case 0: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeWalking\n        case 3: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeTransit\n        default: options[MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeKey] = MKLaunchOptionsDirectionsModeDriving\n        }\n        MKMapItem.openMaps(with: [source, destination], launchOptions: options)\n    }\n\n    private func transportTypeFromSetting(_ value: Int) -&gt; MKDirectionsTransportType {\n        switch value {\n        case 0: return .walking\n        case 3: return .transit\n        default: return .automobile\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage, animationsAllowed: animationsAllowed)\n    }\n\n    // MARK: - Remote updates for the selected device only\n\n    private func fetchTargetDeviceLocation(resetAndRecenter: Bool, ignoreRouteCache: Bool = false) async {\n        // Fetch latest location for just the selected device from the server.",

        "contents": "    private func updateNavigationOverlayStep() {\n        guard let route,\n              let navigationOverlayViewModel,\n              let location = locationManager.currentLocation else { return }\n        guard var stepIndex = closestStepIndex(for: route, to: location.coordinate) else { return }\n        // Never show \"Arrive at destination\" unless user is actually near the destination\n        let lastIndex = route.steps.count - 1\n        if stepIndex == lastIndex, lastIndex &gt; 0 {\n            let lastStep = route.steps[lastIndex]\n            let userPoint = MKMapPoint(location.coordinate)\n            let distanceToDestination = lastStep.polyline.closestDistance(to: userPoint) ??         "contents": "    private func sanitizedPayload(from location: CLLocation) -&gt; UpdateLocationPayload? {\n        let longitude = location.coordinate.longitude\n        let latitude = location.coordinate.latitude\n        let accuracy = location.horizontalAccuracy\n        guard longitude.isFinite, latitude.isFinite, accuracy.isFinite, accuracy &gt;= 0 else {\n            return nil\n        }\n\n        let altitudeValue: Double? = (location.verticalAccuracy &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; location.altitude.isFinite) ? location.altitude : nil\n        let speedValue: Double? = (location.speed &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; location.speed.isFinite) ? location.speed : nil\n        let batteryLevelRaw = UIDevice.current.batteryLevel\n        let batteryPercent: Double? = (batteryLevelRaw &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; batteryLevelRaw.isFinite) ? Double(Int(batteryLevelRaw * 100)) : nil\n        let timestamp = location.timestamp.timeIntervalSince1970\n        guard timestamp.isFinite else { return nil }\n\n        return UpdateLocationPayload(\n            Device: thisDeviceIDManager.shared.deviceID,\n            DeviceKey: settings.deviceKey,\n            Timestamp: String(Int64(timestamp)),\n            Longitude: longitude,\n            Latitude: latitude,\n            HorizontalAccuracy: accuracy,\n            Speed: speedValue,\n            BatteryLevel: batteryPercent,\n            Altitude: altitudeValue\n        )\n    }\n\n\n    // MARK: - Logging\n    private func addUpdateLogEntry(mode: String) {\n        let entry = UpdateLogEntry(timestamp: Date(), mode: mode)\n        updateLog.insert(entry, at: 0)\n        if updateLog.count &gt; 10 {\n            updateLog = Array(updateLog.prefix(10))\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // MARK: - Foreground Location Timer\n    private func startForegroundLocationTimer() {\n        debugLog(\"Starting foreground location timer\")",

        "contents": "    /// and clamping of ratios to keep numerics stable when the device is far outside the region.\n    private func coordinateToScreenPoint(_ coordinate: CLLocationCoordinate2D) -&gt; CGPoint {\n        // Epsilon in degrees to prevent division by near-zero spans (≈ stability only).\n        let eps: CLLocationDegrees = 1e-9\n\n        let latDelta = max(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta, eps)\n        let lonDelta = max(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta, eps)\n\n        // Optional: unwrap longitude difference across the dateline so that long diffs prefer the short arc.\n        let dLon = deltaLongitude(coordinate.longitude, mapRegion.center.longitude)\n        let dLat = coordinate.latitude - mapRegion.center.latitude\n        \n        let latRatioRaw = CGFloat(dLat / latDelta)\n        let lonRatioRaw = CGFloat(dLon / lonDelta)\n\n        // Proportionally scale ratios so the largest magnitude fits within the screen bounds.\n        let maxScreens: CGFloat = 4\n        let maxRatio = max(abs(latRatioRaw), abs(lonRatioRaw))\n        let scale = (maxRatio &gt; maxScreens) ? (maxScreens / maxRatio) : 1\n        let latRatio = latRatioRaw * scale\n        let lonRatio = lonRatioRaw * scale\n\n        let screenX = screenCenter.x + lonRatio * screenSize.width\n        let screenY = screenCenter.y - latRatio * screenSize.height // Inverted Y axis\n        \n        // Debug: Print coordinate conversion details\n        debugLog(\"🌍 Device \\(deviceName) coordinate: \\(coordinate.latitude), \\(coordinate.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"🗺️ Map region center: \\(mapRegion.center.latitude), \\(mapRegion.center.longitude)\")\n        debugLog(\"📏 Map span: \\(mapRegion.span.latitudeDelta), \\(mapRegion.span.longitudeDelta)\")\n        debugLog(\"📊 Ratios (raw/scaled): lat=\\(latRatioRaw)→\\(latRatio), lon=\\(lonRatioRaw)→\\(lonRatio)\")\n        debugLog(\"🖥️ Screen center: \\(screenCenter), screen size: \\(screenSize)\")\n        debugLog(\"🎯 Calculated screen position: \\(screenX), \\(screenY)\")\n        \n        return CGPoint(x: screenX, y: screenY)\n    }\n    ",

        "contents": "    /// 2. Rotate that point by &#96;mapHeading&#96; around &#96;screenCenter&#96;.\n    /// 3. If outside the margin, intersect the center→device ray with all edges and\n    ///    choose the nearest intersection (with corner snapping).\n    /// 4. Compute the rotation so the arrow points towards the (rotated) device point.\n    private func calculateArrowPosition() -&gt; (position: CGPoint, rotation: Double)? {\n        // (A) Guard against invalid/degenerate region spans at the call site if desired:\n        // If you'd prefer to skip rendering entirely while the region is invalid, early-return nil here.\n        // Keeping the robust projection inside coordinateToScreenPoint avoids flicker.\n        \n        // Convert device coordinate to screen position\n        let deviceScreenPointUnrotated = coordinateToScreenPoint(deviceCoordinate)\n        // Rotate the device point around the screen center by the current map heading (invert sign for correct direction)\n        let deviceScreenPoint = rotate(point: deviceScreenPointUnrotated, around: screenCenter, degrees: -mapHeading)\n        \n        // Debug: Print screen coordinates\n        debugLog(\"📍 Device \\(deviceName) screen position (rotated by heading \\(mapHeading)): \\(deviceScreenPoint), screen size: \\(screenSize)\")\n\n        // Check if device is outside screen bounds using visibility hysteresis\n        let isOutsideScreen =\n            deviceScreenPoint.x &lt; visibilityMargin ||\n            deviceScreenPoint.x &gt; screenSize.width - visibilityMargin ||\n            deviceScreenPoint.y &lt; visibilityMargin ||\n            deviceScreenPoint.y &gt; screenSize.height - visibilityMargin\n        \n        debugLog(\"🔍 Device \\(deviceName) is outside screen: \\(isOutsideScreen) (visibilityMargin: \\(visibilityMargin))\")\n        \n        guard isOutsideScreen else {\n            debugLog(\"❌ Device \\(deviceName) is inside screen bounds, no arrow needed\")\n            return nil\n        }\n        \n        // Calculate arrow position on screen edge with intelligent spacing\n        let arrowPosition = calculateIntelligentEdgePosition(deviceScreenPoint: deviceScreenPoint)",

0 || droppedInvalid &gt; 0 {\n            debugLog(\"[DeviceMapView] Normalized history for device \\(deviceID) dropped duplicates=\\(droppedDuplicates) invalid=\\(droppedInvalid)\")\n        }\n\n        return uniqueEntries\n    }\n\n    // Starts the auto-update timer for fetching location\n    private func startAutoUpdate() {\n        stopAutoUpdate() // Cancel any existing timer\n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        guard interval &gt; 0 else { return }\n        timerCancellable = Timer.publish(every: interval, on: .main, in: .common)\n            .autoconnect()\n            .sink { _ in\n                Task { await fetchLocation(resetZoomToSettings: false) }\n            }\n    }\n\n    // Stops the auto-update timer\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    // Restarts the auto-update timer\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Shows the error overlay with a debug and user message\n    private func showErrorOverlay(_ debugMessage: String, _ userMessage: String) {\n        debugLog(\"Error: \\(debugMessage)\")\n        errorOverlayManager.show(message: userMessage, animationsAllowed: animationsAllowed)",

        "contents": "#endif\n    }\n\n#if canImport(AVFoundation)\n    private func configureSessionIfNeeded() {\n        guard !hasConfiguredSession else { return }\n        let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()\n        do {\n            try session.setCategory(.ambient, mode: .default, options: [.mixWithOthers])\n            try session.setActive(true, options: [])\n            hasConfiguredSession = true\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"[SoundEffectPlayer] Failed to configure audio session: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func player(for key: String, name: String, fileExtension: String) -&gt; AVAudioPlayer? {\n        if let cached = players[key] {\n            return cached\n        }\n        guard let url = resolveURL(for: name, fileExtension: fileExtension) else {\n            debugLog(\"[SoundEffectPlayer] Missing sound resource: \\(name).\\(fileExtension)\")\n            return nil\n        }\n        do {\n            let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)\n            player.prepareToPlay()\n            players[key] = player\n            return player\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"[SoundEffectPlayer] Failed to load sound \\(name).\\(fileExtension): \\(error)\")\n            return nil\n        }\n    }\n\n    private func resolveURL(for name: String, fileExtension: String) -&gt; URL? {\n        let subdirectories: [String?] = [nil, \"sounds\", \"Assets/sounds\"]\n        for subdirectory in subdirectories {\n            if let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: name, withExtension: fileExtension, subdirectory: subdirectory) {\n                return url\n            }\n        }\n        let pathCandidates = [\"sounds/\\(name)\", \"Assets/sounds/\\(name)\"]\n        for path in pathCandidates {\n            if let url = Bundle.main.url(forResource: path, withExtension: fileExtension) {\n                return url\n            }\n        }\n        return nil\n    }\n#endif\n}",

Cannot save deviceID.\")\n            return\n        }\n        do {\n            try id.write(to: modernURL, atomically: true, encoding: .utf8)\n            debugLog(\"[DEBUG] deviceID successfully saved to: \\(modernURL.path)\")\n        } catch {\n            debugLog(\"[DEBUG] Error saving deviceID: \\(error)\")\n        }\n    }\n    \n    private func loadDeviceID() -&gt; String? {\n        debugLog(\"[DEBUG] Attempting to load deviceID...\")\n        ensureAppDirectoryExists()\n        // If we cannot resolve the target URL, generate and persist a fresh ID\n        // rather than returning nil.\n        guard let modernURL = modernFileURL else {\n            debugLog(\"[DEBUG] modernFileURL is nil. Generating new deviceID.\")\n            let newID = UUID().uuidString\n            saveDeviceID(newID)\n            return newID\n        }\n        // 1. Prüfe, ob das neue Format existiert\n        if FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: modernURL.path) {\n            debugLog(\"[DEBUG] Found modern deviceID file at: \\(modernURL.path)\")\n            if let id = try? Published Properties\n    @Published var currentLocation: CLLocation?\n    @Published var authorizationStatus: CLAuthorizationStatus = .notDetermined\n    @Published var lastUpdateTime: Date?\n    @Published var isTracking: Bool = false\n    @Published var userHeading: Double?\n    @Published private(set) var isHeadingValid: Bool = false\n    @Published var lastServerUpdate: Date?\n    @Published var serverUpdateStatus: ServerUpdateStatus = .idle\n    @Published var updateLog: [UpdateLogEntry] = []\n    @Published var lastBackgroundUpdate: Date?\n    @Published var backgroundUpdateCount: Int = 0\n    \n    // MARK: - Private Properties\n    private let locationManager = CLLocationManager()\n    private let userDefaults = UserDefaults.standard\n    private let backgroundUpdateCountKey = \"miataru_backgroundUpdateCount\"\n    private let lastBackgroundUpdateKey = \"miataru_lastBackgroundUpdate\"\n    private let backgroundMetricsLastResetKey = \"miataru_backgroundMetricsLastReset\"\n    private let lastServerUpdateKey = \"miataru_lastServerUpdate\"\n    private var cancellables = Set&lt;AnyCancellable&gt;()\n    private let settings = SettingsManager.shared\n    private var foregroundLocationTimer: Timer?\n    private var foregroundLocationUpdateTimerTimeframe: Double = 30\n    private let networkMonitor = NWPathMonitor()\n    @Published private(set) var isNetworkAvailable: Bool = true\n    private let alwaysAuthorizationRequestedKey = \"miataru_always_authorization_requested\"\n    private var lastSmoothedHeading: Double?\n    private let headingSmoothingAlpha: Double = 0.25\n    private let headingAccuracyThreshold: Double = 35",

Made two changes:

1. Prevented `updateFollowCamera()` from interfering: added a check in `updateCoordinates()` to skip calling `updateFollowCamera()` when `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom` is true, so it doesn't override the initial camera setup.

2. Use the current camera position when applying pitch: in step 2, use `currentMapCamera.centerCoordinate` (centered after step 1) instead of the original center variable, so pitch is applied at the correct position.

This should fix the animation sequence. The map should:
1. First center/zoom to the route/user location (pitch 0)
2. Then apply pitch 60 at that centered position
3. Avoid the strange cross-screen animation

---


Made these changes to reduce stuttering:

1. **Increased delay**: Changed from 400ms to 550ms before applying pitch to ensure the centering animation completes (350ms animation + 200ms buffer).

2. **Keep flag active longer**: Keep `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom` true until after the pitch animation completes, preventing `updateFollowCamera()` from interfering during the initial sequence.

3. **Delayed flag reset**: Set `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom = false` only after the pitch animation completes (another 400ms delay), ensuring no camera updates interfere.

4. **Fixed final zoom**: Updated the 2.5-second delayed zoom to check `isNavigationMode` instead of `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom`, since that flag will be false by then.

This should eliminate stuttering by ensuring:
- Centering animation completes fully before pitch is applied
- No camera updates interfere during the initial sequence
- Smooth transition: center → tilt → normal navigation updates

<reproduction_steps>
1. Build and run the app in Debug mode
2. Navigate to a device view that has a route
3. Double-tap on the map to enter navigation mode
4. Observe the animation: it should center smoothly, then tilt smoothly without stuttering
5. Verify the animation is smooth and fluid
6. Stop the app
</reproduction_steps>

The animation should now be smooth without stuttering.

## Summary

Fixed the map tilt issue in double-tap navigation mode:

1. **Root cause**: The double-tap handler only enabled navigation mode when `isRouteReversed == true`, but it was `false` in the test case.

2. **Fix**: Updated `handleMapDoubleTap()` to enable navigation mode regardless of route direction.

3. **Animation sequence**: Adjusted the sequence to:
   - First center/zoom to the route/user location (pitch 0)
   - Then apply pitch (60 degrees) after centering completes
   - Prevent `updateFollowCamera()` from interfering during the initial sequence

4. **Timing**: Increased delays and kept `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom` active longer to prevent stuttering and ensure smooth animations.

The map now tilts correctly when entering double-tap navigation mode, with a smooth animation sequence.

## Summary of Changes

**Commit**: `072c0b26` - "Add map tilt in double-tap navigation mode and improve animation sequence"

### Changes Made:

1. **Added map tilt in navigation mode**
   - Added `navigationPitch` constant (60 degrees) for default tilt angle
   - Camera now tilts when entering double-tap navigation mode

2. **Fixed double-tap handler**
   - Updated `handleMapDoubleTap()` to enable navigation mode regardless of `isRouteReversed`
   - Previously only worked when route was reversed; now works in both directions

3. **Improved animation sequence**
   - Two-step sequence: first center/zoom (pitch 0), then apply tilt (pitch 60) after centering completes
   - Prevents stuttering and cross-screen movement
   - Uses 550ms delay to ensure centering animation completes before tilting

4. **Prevented interference during setup**
   - Added check in `updateCoordinates()` to skip `updateFollowCamera()` when `shouldPerformInitialNavigationZoom` is true
   - Keeps flag active until pitch animation completes to prevent conflicting camera updates

5. **Fixed auto-stop navigation**
   - Updated `stopNavigation()` to properly exit navigation mode and clear route
   - Ensures clean state when navigation stops automatically

**Files Modified**: 
- `miataru/views/iPhone/Devices Views/iPhone_DeviceNavigationView.swift` (+143 lines, -12 lines)

The map now tilts smoothly when entering double-tap navigation mode, with a clean animation sequence.
